summary.text: Scott Shepard is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired business leader and member of the Barrington Planning Board.

paragraphs.text: Shepard earned a high school diploma from Williston Northampton School, a bachelor's degree from Emory University in 1981 and a Ph.D. from Indiana University in 1987, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes work as a business consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Shepard said he is a Barrington Planning Board member, an Advisory Budget Committee member and chair of the town's Capital Improvement Program Committee.
He said he is passionate about fiscal stewardship, public education, housing affordability, childcare and workforce development.
